note: Static explainers for Macro Engine pillars, keyed by engine row id. Content: Hercules (COLLAB.md spec, 2026-10-08). Update `live` as conditions change.

fiscal.body: Deficits, debt sustainability, sovereign spreads. Funds stress leaks into the currency.
fiscal.live: Moody's SPARED France (Oct 23): Aa3 affirmed, negative outlook — vs the widely expected A1 cut; wants a deficit-cutting 2027 budget, debt >120% of GDP in 2027; S&P reviews France Nov 27. OAT-Bund 170-177bp (15-yr high); France 10Y 5.14% (highest since July 2002); revenue vote Tuesday; unions strike Nov 5. UK: Healey's first Budget Wednesday (CGT rise off the table, bank tax £2-5B, headroom £23.6B→~£15B). No US shutdown — CR through Dec 11.
fiscal.title: Fiscal & sovereign risk

growth.body: Who is accelerating, who is stalling (GDP, jobs, PMIs). Always comparative. Stronger growth pulls in capital and raises hike expectations.
growth.live: US Q3 GDP advance Thu (cons 3.0% SAAR, GDPNow 3.5%, Continuum 2.8%); German Ifo Mon; EZ Q3 GDP Fri; German Q3 GDP Fri; Canada Aug GDP Fri. Last week: US claims 194K (near 57-yr lows), flash comp 57.6 inline; EZ comp 51.9 miss (France 48.4 contraction); UK comp 53.1 beat; AU comp 47.7 miss (first contraction in 5 months).
growth.title: Growth differentials

inflation.body: CPI/PCE vs the central bank's target. High inflation alone strengthens nothing — what matters is what the bank does about it.
inflation.live: US Sep PCE Thu (headline +0.5% m/m exp — largest since March; core +0.3% m/m); AU Q3 CPI Wed (trimmed +1.0% q/q consensus; Hauser 'materially worse'); EZ flash CPI Fri; German flash CPI Fri; Tokyo CPI Thu. US CPI 3.7%, import prices +8.1% y/y; Brent $116.72 — energy re-acceleration risk.
inflation.title: Inflation

policy.body: Central banks moving in different directions. It is the gap between them that moves currencies: money flows toward higher rates.
policy.live: Triple-decision Wednesday: RBNZ 8pm CT Tue (hike ~85-89% to 3.00%), BoC 8:45am CT (hike ~75-80%; TD dissents), FOMC 1pm CT (hold ~91-93%; Dec hike >80%; blackout). ECB Thu 8:15am CT (hold ~93-97%; presser on OATs/TPI). BoJ Fri (hold; Dec ~83-88%; Outlook Report). RBA Nov 2-3 (~50/50; Q3 CPI Wed the pivot).
policy.title: Policy divergence

positioning.body: Where speculators already stand (CFTC COT, Fridays). When nearly everyone has made the same bet, it can unwind fast: if everyone is long dollars, nobody is left to buy. The contrarian lens — where would a surprise hurt most.
positioning.live: New CFTC (Oct 20, released Oct 23): euro net short largest since Mar-2020 (contrarian +1 — squeeze side up); hedge funds cut yen shorts, added AUD longs, more bearish CAD (net short largest since early Aug — squeeze fuel into BoC); more bullish GBP. Dollar longs <$40B (down from $44.5B). No crowded-long unwind risk — the pain trade is the euro-short squeeze.
positioning.title: Positioning

risk.body: Risk-on vs risk-off. Fear bids USD, JPY, CHF (havens) and sells AUD, NZD, GBP (risk proxies).
risk.live: Weekend risk bid: Trump 'another little Epic Fury' on Iran; envoy Barrack: weekend strike 'absolutely' possible; US withdrew diplomats/relatives from Saudi; Houthi claims on Yanbu port/oil field/airport; 7 tankers struck/mined in Hormuz (IRIB). Moody's spared France — relief into Monday. VIX ~19; 10Y 5.00%.
risk.title: Risk sentiment

tot.body: Export prices vs import prices: oil, metals. The same price moves two currencies opposite ways — say which and why.
tot.live: Brent $116.72 (+3.1% Fri, +6.2% wk — highest close since April); WTI $103.27 (+3.8% Fri, +4.3% wk — 22-week high). Energy-exporter tailwind (CAD, AUD); energy-importer tax (EUR, JPY). Gold $3,995.81 — first close below $4,000 since July (-4.1% wk); no haven bid (Treasuries/yen/franc took it).
tot.title: Terms of trade
